We Are Faith Connect Youth 🔥

We are not a church program. We are a family of young people on fire for Jesus, raising a generation that will not bow to this world.

Our Mission

To Connect Youth To Faith

Faith Connect Youth was born in Douala with one burden: youths are lost in drugs, sex, depression and fake life on social media. We want to bring them back to Jesus with real talk, not religion.

We do this through daily devotionals, bible study, prayer wall, forum and physical events.

Our Vision

A Generation On Fire

To raise 10,000 youths across Cameroon who know the Word, live pure, and win souls. Not church goers, but disciples.

Habakkuk 2:14 - For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD.

Our Values
🔵 Faith

We believe the Bible is true and Jesus is the only way.

⚫ Purity

We stand for purity in a dirty world. No compromise.

⚪ Family

No one walks alone. We lift each other in love.
